text:
emma_cs: Quick weekly pulse for AtlasGrid private deployment. Please drop 1-2 line region notes. Top concerns: eu-central cert rotation yesterday (did it cause any key syncs?), ap-northeast seeing HSM latency spikes overnight, small spend bump. Need logs for renewal packet. :mag_right:

rajan_infra: eu-central-1: we rotated certs in the control plane at 03:15 UTC. Most nodes healthy but saw key-sync lag in az-3 for ~12m -> caused ~300 502s on key-lookup route. Root cause: backlog while worker restarted. Mitigated by replaying queued syncs; confirmed KV parity. Logs: `https://internal-logs/atlasgrid/eu-central/kms/2024-11-02.gz` (internal). Will add a post-rotate check to avoid replays. :white_check_mark:

noah_sre: ap-northeast-1: HSM latency spike between 01:40-02:20 JST. Observed p95 KMS latency jump 60ms -> 1.2s. Vendor reported a firmware job overlapping customer window (we flagged scheduling mismatch). Temporary mitigation: auto-failover to standby HSM pool; failover roll completed at 02:26 JST. Opened vendor ticket HSM-998. Adding a guard to avoid vendor overlap windows.

olivia_custeng: Customer asked if this is something that could affect renewal. They want a simple one-page timeline + hourly error CSV for the 24h window around each event. Can we generate the CSVs and a short timeline by EOD? They're also asking for a short note on controls we have for HSM maintenance windows.

rajan_infra: I can produce the CSVs. Command I'll run: ```curl -s "https://metrics.internal/atlasgrid/kms/errors?start=2024-11-01T20:00Z&end=2024-11-03T04:00Z" -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' > atlasgrid_kms_errors_24h.csv``` Will upload to the shared folder and tag the account exec. Due: EOD.

noah_sre: also recommending we enable short-circuit caching for key id lookups for AtlasGrid (TTL 30s) to reduce pressure during HSM flaps. Low risk for their workload. Can stage change in canary (10% traffic) tonight.

emma_cs: sounds good. On spend: tokens up ~12% wk/wk; majority from retry storms during both incidents. Suggest temporary throttling + caching as Noah suggested.

rajan_infra: opened CR-2042 to add key-lookup caching + backoff. Can deploy canary at 23:00 UTC. If green, full rollout at 03:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: infra/CR-2042 -> canary @ 2024-11-02T23:00:00Z. CI: passed. :gear:

noah_sre: quick error snippet from ap-northeast agent: ```ERROR KMS: timeout waiting for HSM response (id=0x7f8b) retry=3``` Adding circuit-breaker that trips at >50 concurrent timeouts and returns 503 fast. Patch in staging.

olivia_custeng: For the renewal pack I'll draft: timeline + CSVs + mitigation controls (caching, backoff, vendor scheduling policy). Will review with you Emma before sending to AE. Target: tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

rajan_infra: CSV uploaded: `https://files.redwood.internal/atlasgrid/atlasgrid_kms_errors_24h.csv` (internal link). Pinged AE.

noah_sre: canary deploy started at 2024-11-02T23:12Z. Early metrics: cache hit rate 21% on canary routes, KMS p95 down 40% in canary. No regressions observed.

emma_cs: action items recap: 1) Rajan: confirm CSV link in renewal pack + post-rotate check added (due EOD) 2) Noah: circuit-breaker rollout plan + canary metrics (due after canary finishes) 3) Olivia: draft renewal note + controls language (due tomorrow 10:00 UTC) 4) All: react when done.

deploy-bot: Canary finished @ 2024-11-03T00:45:00Z :white_check_mark: (canary=10%, CR-2042)

noah_sre: full rollout scheduled 2024-11-03T03:00Z pending post-canary review. I'll post final numbers after 03:20 UTC.

emma_cs: thanks team. No Sev declared. Closing this check-in; will reopen if any regression. :v:
